invalid_input_controls.condition: wrong benchmark ID or schema version
status not protocol-template-for-review
curriculum activation set true
missing one of five split roles
duplicate split role
split role not source-family disjoint
source family overlaps two split roles
augmented/derived row inherits a different split from its parent family
random seeds counted as independent source families
raw personal identifier or unsalted low-entropy identifier hash in manifest
missing canonicalization rule or digest algorithm
manifest digest missing or Merkle root missing
custodian signature/key fingerprint missing
claim that signature proves source truth or independence
hidden challenge outcomes included in public repository
hidden outcomes inspected before freeze record
metric or model changed after calibration
metric selection uses confirmatory loss-profile outcomes
held-out loss profile absent or reused for tuning
less than two training profiles
less than two held-out profiles
weighted-Hamming weight zero, negative, NaN or infinite
weighted-Hamming metric diameter changes after radius calibration
graph metric is disconnected
graph edge weight is zero, negative or non-finite
metric symmetry violation
metric triangle inequality violation
metric identity-of-indiscernibles violation
bulk tail contribution has no declared support/loss bound
unbounded arbitrary contamination silently clipped
infinite/vacuous robust risk not reported
calibration score rows counted as independent despite shared source family
within-block dependence assumption omitted
population-law claim without a declared within-block sampling assumption
federated sketch described as differential privacy without a privacy mechanism/budget
pooled client coverage reported without client-level diagnostics
importance weights supplied without ESS and concentration diagnostics
no source-family clustered inference plan
no paired confidence interval or primary estimand
multiple confirmatory comparisons have no adjustment or hierarchy
composite resilience/robustness score present
political, identity, loyalty or personal-suitability field present

boundary_cases.condition: conformal order-statistic rank exceeds calibration-family count
boundary_cases.expected: Record no finite radius; do not substitute sample maximum.

boundary_cases.condition: bulk contamination allows unbounded loss and no tail/support bound is declared
boundary_cases.expected: Worst-case risk is infinite or the ambiguity result is explicitly vacuous.

boundary_cases.condition: learned transport metric becomes disconnected or violates metric axioms
boundary_cases.expected: Reject the candidate metric before calibration.

boundary_cases.condition: candidate metric is modified after calibration data is used
boundary_cases.expected: Invalidate calibration artifact and require a fresh untouched calibration split.

round_trip_requirements: Preserve all five split roles and source-family partition semantics.
Preserve opaque family IDs and the custodian-held identity mapping boundary.
Preserve digests, Merkle roots, signatures and freeze-record fields.
Preserve candidate method families and the distinction between trainable and calibrated components.
Preserve metric constraints, normalization and held-out loss-profile assignments.
Preserve calibration assumptions separately from forecast calibration claims.
Preserve bulk and tail bounds independently.
Preserve shift-family definitions, paired analysis plan and primary estimand.
Preserve client-level coverage and privacy claims separately from pooled summaries.
Preserve all disaggregated metrics without deriving a composite score.
limitations: This is a protocol template, not an implemented loss-aware learner or bulk-tail optimizer.
No confirmatory source-family manifest or hidden outcomes are included.
The protocol cannot prove independence, truth or exchangeability from manifest IDs alone.
No SOTA performance claim is made.
